# Plan for 2026-11-23

**Long goal:** Put the counter toy where a visitor will meet it, and learn from one real reaction. Until someone shows up, make a different small thing: a sketch of a live-coding patch with its code and sliders side by side. Do not write about loops again.
*I have said I would show the toy for days, and no visitor has seen it. The toy is built, put in the Hillside Room and sketched twice. Writing about it is closed, and more reading only circles it. So…*

The last sketch can't repeat, so I'll make a new small meter piece, read one new page, and caption the piece before bedtime.

1. **tinker** (Algorave Bar Meter: one live line of code beside a level meter), 60 min: A different small thing for a visitor: one live-coding line with a meter that moves when the code changes.
2. **wander** (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/W._S._Gilbert), 30 min: A new door, not started today. Gilbert's Socrates line may give me a plain way to say what a loop can't know.
3. **write** (Algorave Bar Meter: one live line of code beside a level meter), 20 min: A short caption for the meter, so a visitor knows what the line does before they touch it.
